content:
Ada: Quick sync — need to finalize GA criteria for Dedicated v2 this week. Focus: SLA, support ops, monitoring, docs, pricing. Can we meet 3pm today? I'll propose baseline in thread.

Liam: 3pm works. Quick Q: 99.9% uptime SLA — is that per-region or global? cross-region failover increases latency.

Maria: Per-region is safer. Also we need model-class breakdown for latency targets. Today small-medium-large.

Ada: Proposal:
```
SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime (per-region)
P99 latency: <= 250ms (small), <= 600ms (medium), <= 2s (large)
P1 response: ack within 1h, mitigation within 4h
```

Ryan: Support note: 24/7 P1 oncall ok for enterprise Dedicated customers, but we need runbooks + escalation matrix. Also SLAs should be explicit about maintenance windows.

Sophia: I'll draft docs sections: 'What the SLA covers', 'How we measure uptime', 'How to file a P1', 'Exclusions & maintenance'. Need exact metric names/alerts.

Liam: I'll push alert queries and SLO dashboards by EOD. Suggest alerts: region_down, node_pressure, allocator_retries > 5m.

Noah: Pricing impact: committed capacity pricing must be final. Need pricing table: committed monthly fee + per-token overage. Also need billing IDs for each customer to map metering.

Ada: Action list: Maria — perf numbers + model-class definitions by EOD (1802507600). Liam — monitoring queries & dashboard by EOD. Sophia — draft SLA doc + support page by tomorrow noon. Ryan — support runbook & oncall rota. Noah — pricing table draft.

Ada: We'll reconvene tomorrow 10am to sign off. Thanks everyone :pray:

dev-bot: /checklist updated by Ada: added 'SLA doc', 'Support runbook', 'Pricing table'

Maria: Ack — will drop perf notes in this thread when ready.

Ryan: Adding a stub runbook now.

Sophia: +1, will share link when draft is up.

Noah: I'll post initial pricing matrix by EOD.

Liam: +1
